# MAKIL

> MAKIL is a private house led by Makil-Herrero Richard, orchestrator of private dinners that cannot be replicated, based in Paris: one name, one point of contact, one line of responsibility. By introduction only.

Makil-Herrero Richard orchestrates private dinners that cannot be reproduced: one room, one table, one evening, and a sequence that disappears with the guests. The house is present in Paris, Monaco, London, Geneva, Dubai, Rome, Luxembourg and New York. It works only by introduction, never by solicitation, and does not publish prices.
